privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How Aman Academy collects, uses and protects personal data.

p: Account details: your name in English and, if you provide it, in Arabic (for certificates), email address, mobile number and password (stored only in hashed form).
Company accounts: company name, contact person and, optionally, commercial registration and VAT numbers.
Training records: enrolments, attendance recorded by the instructor, exam attempts and results, and certificates issued to you.
We do not ask for national ID or Iqama numbers by default.
To provide the training you book, give you joining instructions, record attendance, run exams and issue certificates.
To let a company that paid for your seat see your enrolment, attendance, exam outcome and certificate. Your exam answers are not shared with your company.
To send you service emails such as confirmations and password resets.
Anyone with a certificate number can see the holder's name, the course, the issue and expiry dates and the certificate's status. No contact details or exam information are shown.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you use Aman Academy and book training.

p: Aman Academy provides live, instructor-led online training sessions, online knowledge exams and digital certificates.

Courses are delivered online and assess knowledge. They do not include hands-on practical assessment and do not by themselves satisfy any qualification required by a regulator or employer unless expressly stated.
You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details secure and for the accuracy of the name you provide, which is printed on certificates.
Company managers are responsible for inviting only people they are authorised to enrol.
Attendance is recorded by the instructor. You must attend under your own name.
Exams must be taken by the enrolled learner without assistance. Attempt limits, time limits and pass marks are shown on each course page.
A certificate is issued when the attendance and exam requirements are met. Aman Academy may revoke a certificate issued in error or obtained through dishonesty, and will record the reason.
Prices are shown in Saudi riyals. VAT, where applicable, is shown at checkout.
